query:
UPDATE channel_label
               SET team_id = $3, user_id = $4, name = $5,
                   name_contains = COALESCE($6, name_contains),
                   sort_order = COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sort_order) + 1 FROM channel_label WHERE scope_key = $7), 0),
                   updated_at = now()
               WHERE scope_key = $1 AND id = $2
